outcome: Transfer of infant to neonatal ward
cohort: Pregnant women from the Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort Study (MoBa) linked to the Medical Birth Registry of Norway, including 706 pregnancies with epilepsy
finding: Prepregnancy overweight in women with epilepsy was associated with an increased risk of various pregnancy and delivery complications, including cesarean section, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, and transfer of the infant to a neonatal ward.
mod_finding: Overweight women with epilepsy had an increased risk of cesarean section compared to both overweight women without epilepsy and normal-weight women with epilepsy.
